name: Jiska
title: Haran's Daughter
summary: Jiska (Hebrew: Yiskah) was the daughter of Haran and sister to Lot and Milcah. She is briefly mentioned in Genesis 11:29. According to Jewish tradition (Talmud and Rashi), Jiska is identified with Sarah, Abraham's wife, but this is an interpretation not directly confirmed in the biblical text.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Haran's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jiska is mentioned as the daughter of Haran, along with her siblings Lot and Milcah, in the genealogy of Terah.

keyEvents.title: Haran's Death in Ur
keyEvents.description: Jiska's father Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in his native land, while his father Terah was still alive.

keyEvents.title: The Family in Ur of the Chaldeans
keyEvents.description: Jiska belonged to the family of Terah who lived in Ur of the Chaldeans, a prominent family that later became central in God's redemptive history.

keyEvents.title: Milcah's marriage to Nahor
keyEvents.description: Jiska's sister Milcah was married to their uncle Nahor, Abraham's brother. This family connection tightly linked Jiska's lineage to Abraham's family.
